sg1.intro: The main Scotch Gambit: meet Bb4+ with Bd2, win the pawn back, and castle.
notes: e4 grabs a big share of the centre and opens lines for the bishop and queen.
e5 claims a matching share of the centre and opens a path for the dark-squared bishop.
Nf3 develops a knight towards the centre and attacks the pawn on e5.
Nc6 develops a knight and defends the pawn on e5.
d4 strikes at the centre straight away. It eyes the pawn on e5.
exd4 takes the pawn on d4. That pawn move takes a share of the centre.
Bc4 aims at f7, Black's weak spot.
Bc5 develops the dark-squared bishop.
c3 attacks the pawn on d4. White is offering a gambit pawn.
Nf6 develops a knight towards the centre and attacks the pawn on e4.
cxd4 takes the pawn on d4 and attacks the bishop on c5. That pawn move takes a share of the centre.
Bb4+ moves the bishop to b4 and gives check. It eyes the king on e1.
Bd2 develops the dark-squared bishop and attacks the bishop on b4.
Bxd2+ takes the bishop on d2 and gives check. It also eyes the king on e1.
Nbxd2 recaptures the bishop on d2 and develops a knight.
d5 strikes at the centre and attacks the bishop on c4. It eyes the pawn on e4.
exd5 takes the pawn on d5 and attacks the knight on c6. That pawn move takes a share of the centre.
Nxd5 recaptures the pawn on d5.
O-O castles the king to safety and brings a rook towards the centre.
O-O castles the black king to safety. The king steps aside and a rook comes into the game.
